name: Steamhouse India Limited
summary: Steamhouse India Limited develops, owns, operates, and maintains centralized steam generation plants and distributes industrial steam through pipeline networks to industrial customers. The company provides steam generation and distribution services, nitrogen compression and distribution, utility plant operation and maintenance, and engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and utility management services. It also designs and operates boiler systems, pipelines, water treatment systems, pollution control equipment, and SCADA-based monitoring systems.
